q31.sampleAnswer:
To: Andy
From: Amy
Hello Andi!!!
I hope you’re not busy. There’s going to be a great movie at the cinema tommorow. It’s called “Beauty and the beast”. Would you like to come to the cinema with me? My mum will take me there. See you!!!
Amy

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：邀请 Andi 一起去电影院；说明想去电影院的原因；说明怎么去那里
条理性：衔接连贯，使用连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的准确性与丰富性

anchors.response:
To: Andy
From: Amy
Hello Andi!!!
I hope you’re not busy. There’s going to be a great movie at the cinema tommorow. It’s called “Beauty and the beast”. Would you like to come to the cinema with me? My mum will take me there. See you!!!

anchors.noteZh: 紧扣题目，清楚表达了三个内容要点；用了一些衔接手段（It’s, there），行文连贯；日常词汇使用恰当（busy, movie），熟练运用简单语法结构（I hope you’re not, There’s going to be, Would you like to）。内容5/条理性5/语言5。

anchors.response:

q31.explanationZh: 满分邮件要写清三点：邀请 Andi 一起去看电影、说明为什么想去、说明怎么去电影院（例如谁送、坐什么车），并用连接词把句子连起来。

q32.sampleAnswer: Raju and Siew Hong are best friend, but Andy is Siew Hong’s neighbour. One day, three of them were in the garden that was very near to their house. Andy is a very shy and clever guy, so he was reading his book and sat on the grass while Raju and Siew Hong were playing baseketball. Both of them were a very successful (basketball player). After a will, Siew Hong threw the ball to Andy and invited him to join both of them. After Andy made up his mind, he joined them immediately. They taught him how to play basketball. And soon, they became best friends, and often plays basketball together.

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：男孩坐在草地上看书，其他男孩在打篮球；球飞向他，他接住了球；他和其他男孩一起打篮球
条理性：衔接连贯，使用连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的准确性与丰富性

anchors.response: Raju and Siew Hong are best friend, but Andy is Siew Hong’s neighbour. One day, three of them were in the garden that was very near to their house. Andy is a very shy and clever guy, so he was reading his book and sat on the grass while Raju and Siew Hong were playing baseketball. Both of them were a very successful (basketball player). After a will, Siew Hong threw the ball to Andy and invited him to join both of them. After Andy made up his mind, he joined them immediately. They taught him how to play basketball. And soon, they became best friends, and often plays basketball together.
anchors.noteZh: 紧扣题目，充分传达了故事信息；用了基本连接词和衔接手段（but, that, so, while, them, After），行文连贯；日常词汇大体恰当（best friend, neighbour, shy, basketball player, invited），熟练运用简单语法结构（were in the garden, was reading, were playing, They taught him how to），错误极少。内容5/条理性5/语言5。

anchors.response: On a Saturday afternoon Logan is reading a book in the park. He is reading a scary book. Other children are playing basketball. After, that, Logan stand up and start play with children. Logan was play basketball 3 years ago. He play basketball great. When they finish, Logan put the book in the bag and go home.
anchors.noteZh: 写到了第一、三幅图的情节，但第二幅图只提到部分内容，读者只能大致了解故事；用了基本连接词和一些衔接手段（After, that [应为 After that], and, When）；有一些相关基本词语（Saturday afternoon, a scary book, basketball, bag），简单语法结构基本正确（is reading, in the park, they finish, put the book in the bag）。内容3/条理性3/语言3。

q32.explanationZh: 满分故事要写出三幅图的内容：男孩在公园草地上看书、别的男孩在打篮球；球飞过来，他接住了球；他加入大家一起打篮球，并用连接词把情节连贯地串起来。
